verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents a way to choose where it processes audio across available regions, and it offers its own self-hosted, on-prem and on-device deployments that keep data in the customer's environment. The global endpoint auto-routes to the nearest region, which implies region-specific endpoints also exist. missing for 10: the list of available regions, explicit confirmation that stored data (e.g. batch job artifacts) stays in the selected region rather than only being processed there, residency/compliance guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
